results.name: Cable Split Squat
instructions: Stand in front of a low pulley cable machine with a bar attached and grab it with both hands using an overhand grip. Take a step back into a split stance with one foot forward and one foot behind.
Hold the bar extended along the cable and keep your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your thigh is parallel to the floor. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Keep your front knee aligned with your ankle throughout the movement.
Lower yourself slowly to avoid unnecessary strain on the knee joint.
Avoid locking out the knees at the top to keep muscles under tension.
results.description: Cable Split Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Cable Standing Leg Extension
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a high pulley and secure it around your right ankle. Stand facing away from the machine and hold onto a stable surface for balance.
Bend the knee of the strapped leg so your heel is close to your glutes.
Slowly extend your leg by straightening the knee and then return it to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, switch legs, and repeat.
tips: Avoid locking out your knee at the top to keep constant tension.
Start with light resistance to perfect form and avoid joint strain.
Make sure your thighs remain in line throughout the motion.
results.description: Cable Standing Leg Extension is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a cable, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Calf Raise Leg Press Machine
instructions: Sit on the leg press machine and position your feet shoulder-width apart on the higher portion of the footplate with your toes pointing up.
Press the footplate by extending your legs and keeping a slight bend in your knees.
Push through your forefeet to raise the footplate as much as possible, squeezing your calf muscles.
Slowly lower your forefeet down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Keep your legs slightly bent throughout the exercise to avoid placing stress on your knees.
Focus on a full range of motion, pushing your forefeet as much as possible for deep muscle activation.
Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Calf Raise Leg Press Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.

results.name: Calf Raise on Hack Squat Machine
instructions: Stand on the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and your feet hips-width apart on the foot platform, with your toes pointing forward and your heels hanging off the edge.
Extend your legs to release the safety handles, keeping a slight bend in your knees.
Push through your forefeet to raise your heels as high as possible, squeezing your calf muscles at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your legs slightly bent throughout the exercise to avoid placing stress on your knees.
Focus on a full range of motion, lowering your heels as much as possible for a deep muscle activation.
Exhale as you raise your heels and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Calf Raise on Hack Squat Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.

results.name: Clamshell
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked, knees bent at about 90 degrees, and your hips aligned. Rest your head on your bottom arm and place your top hand on your hip for support.
Keep your feet together and your core engaged.
Raise your top knee upward as far as possible without rotating your hips or lifting your feet off each other. Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your knee back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked and avoid rolling your body backward as you lift your knee.
Engage your core throughout to stabilize your torso.
Use slow, controlled movements to maintain constant tension on the muscles.
results.description: Clamshell is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hips.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back and place the heel of one foot on an elevated surface. Cross your opposite ankle over the supporting thigh and hold a dumbbell securely across your hips.
Press through the elevated heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your supporting knee.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your glutes while keeping your hips level.
Lower your hips toward the floor with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Drive through your supporting heel instead of pushing through your toes.
Lift your hips without overextending or arching your lower back.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating toward the crossed leg.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you lift them.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a box, with your knees bent at 90 degrees. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
Engage your glutes and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
Lower your hips with control to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a box, your left knee bent at about 90 degrees, and your right leg extended towards the ceiling. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
Engage your glutes and press through your heel to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back and place both feet on an elevated surface, with one foot on the edge and the other slightly forward so only the heel rests on top. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
Engage your glutes and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
Lower your hips with control to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Figure Four Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your right ankle across your left knee in a figure four position and rest a dumbbell on your hips, holding it securely with both hands.

Engage your glutes and press through the heel of your supporting foot to lift your hips off the ground, extending through your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knee.
Lower your hips back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your figure four leg relaxed and stable throughout the movement.
Focus on pressing through your heel rather than your toes to target the glutes.
Position the dumbbell securely and consider using a pad or towel for added comfort.
results.description: Dumbbell Figure Four Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.
